articles.title: El papa León XIV se despide de Argentina: “Me he sentido como en casa”
articles.summary: León XIV se despide de Argentina y expresa su gratitud por la acogida de los fieles durante su visita apostólica.
articles.body_text: “Gracias por recibirme con tanto cariño, me he sentido como en casa”, así se despidió este miércoles León XIV de Argentina tras celebrar una misa ante dos millones de fieles en el santuario de Nuestra Señora de Luján. “Queridos hermanos y hermanas: doy gracias a Dios por lo vivido en mi visita a este país, cuna de nuestro querido papa Francisco. Agradezco a todos los que trabajaron para que esto fuera posible”, dijo el papa estadounidense y peruano antes de viajar a Perú para la última etapa de su gira por Latinoamérica. Exclamó ante la multitud que llegó al santuario de la patrona del país: “¡Gracias Argentina por recibirme con los brazos abiertos!”, después de haber pasado tres días en el país y visitar Córdoba además de la capital. “La imagen de la Virgen de Luján que hoy nos acompaña llegó a estas tierras en una carreta y ya no quiso continuar su camino, se quedó para siempre con ustedes. El Sucesor de Pedro hoy debe seguir su misión en otros lugares, allí donde el Señor lo envía, pero quiere decirles que los lleva a todos en su corazón”, añadió. Y continuó: “Que Dios bendiga esta tierra de María Inmaculada, cuyo manto celeste y blanco se quedó en los colores de su bandera. Que los pueblos del norte con sus cerros y valles, del sur con sus imponentes glaciares, del este con sus ríos y selvas, y del oeste con sus cordilleras majestuosas, den gloria al Señor por tantos dones recibidos y, en su nombre, vayan y anuncien el Evangelio con alegría y gratitud”.

articles.title: ¿El mes de noviembre tiene feriados? Revisa cuáles son los días NO laborables en Perú
articles.summary: El calendario peruano de 2026 contempla fechas especiales durante noviembre. Conoce cuántos feriados quedan este mes, qué días se celebran y si habrá jornadas de descanso para los trabajadores del sector público y privado.
articles.body_text: Los días libres son una oportunidad para compartir tiempo en familia, organizar actividades personales o realizar pequeños viajes sin las obligaciones habituales del trabajo. En noviembre de 2026, el calendario peruano contempla fechas de descanso que deben distinguirse entre feriados nacionales y días no laborables establecidos de manera extraordinaria. Estas últimas disposiciones están vinculadas con la visita del papa León XIV al Perú y comprenden jornadas y horarios específicos en Lima, Callao y otras regiones del país. Además, no todos los trabajadores tendrán las mismas condiciones para acceder a estos descansos, pues algunas medidas requieren compensar posteriormente las horas que se dejen de trabajar. Conoce qué fechas están previstas para noviembre, en qué lugares se aplicarán y cuáles son las diferencias que debes tener en cuenta antes de organizar tus actividades. El calendario de noviembre tiene un feriado nacional, el pasado 1 de noviembre, día de todos los santos, sin embargo; también cuenta con días NO laborables según lo indica la ley. Estas últimas fueron oficializadas mediante el Decreto Supremo N.º 020-2026-TR, publicado en el diario oficial El Peruano. El calendario contempla las siguientes fechas: La compensación dependerá del sector laboral. En las entidades públicas, las horas pendientes deberán recuperarse dentro de los diez días posteriores al descanso o cuando lo determine el titular de cada institución, de acuerdo con las necesidades del servicio. En las empresas privadas, empleadores y trabajadores podrán acordar cómo reponer el tiempo no trabajado. Si no consiguen llegar a un consenso, el empleador establecerá las condiciones para realizar la compensación correspondiente. Aunque ambas fechas permiten interrumpir las actividades habituales, tienen condiciones distintas. El feriado constituye un descanso obligatorio reconocido por ley y no requiere recuperar las horas que correspondían a esa jornada. En cambio, los días no laborables suelen estar dirigidos principalmente al sector público y contemplan la recuperación posterior del tiempo pendiente. Para los trabajadores privados, su aplicación depende del acuerdo entre empleadores y trabajadores. Según la Cámara de Comercio de Lima (CCL), si un empleado trabaja en un día feriado debido a necesidades de la empresa o rotación de turnos, y no recibe un día libre en sustitución, debe recibir una compensación económica equivalente a tres veces su salario habitual por esa jornada laboral. Esto se debe a tres conceptos: No cumplir con el pago adicional o negar la compensación de descanso constituye una infracción muy grave en materia laboral. Las sanciones económicas varían según el tipo de empresa, y pueden ir desde poco más de 1.000 soles hasta superar los 24.000.

articles.summary: This Congressional investigation into Nvidia's China sales and its dealings with Trump is the second one, so far, since news of the alleged spy affair broke.
articles.body_text: Democrats on Thursday opened an inquiry into how the Trump administration handled Nvidia’s chip sales to China. Earlier on Thursday, the company ousted its CEO Jensen Huang . He also agreed to testify to a different set of Republican-led Congressional committees. Huang was removed from the company he founded after he confessed to an extramarital affair with a woman accused of being a Chinese spy. (He has since been accused of having more affairs , with Nvidia employees.) The alleged Chinese spy, Alice Huang, was an executive of Nvidia customer Megaspeed, a Singapore-based company that U.S. officials suspect of helping route advanced Nvidia chips into China. The Democratic inquiry comes from Rep. Richard Neal (D-Mass.), the top Democrat on the House Ways and Means Committee, and Sen. Ron Wyden (D-Ore.), the top Democrat on the Senate Finance Committee. As the minority party, they can ask questions but can’t compel answers. Their humdinger of a letter to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick asks the department to preserve records about an arrangement they find questionable and, they allege, illegal. “The scheme worked like this,” as the letter describes it. President Trump agreed to sales of Nvidia’s H200 chips to China as long as the chips, manufactured by Taiwan, were first shipped to the United States. On arriving, Trump added a tariff “effectively taking a cut of Nvidia’s sales to China through what appears to be an unconstitutional export tax system,” the letter said. Then the Commerce Department, under Lutnick, issued an export license. By the way, the deal between Trump and Nvidia to share revenue was public. In August 2025, Nvidia and AMD both agreed to share 15% of their revenue from chip sales to China with the U.S. government as part of a deal to secure export licenses, the AP reported at the time. But the letter questions why Lutnick continued to allow Megaspeed to buy chips even after he was reportedly informed by U.S. intelligence of their suspicions of Alice Huang and of Jensen Huang’s relationship with her. It questions why the department reportedly green-lit other Asian companies to buy Nvidia chips “with no physical presence at their listed addresses.” So the inquiry is aimed at the administration, not just at Nvidia and Huang. The letter also questions how Nvidia’s donations to Trump’s projects factored in. It notes that the export deal was approved after Trump learned of “Mr. Huang’s compromised position” in sleeping with an alleged spy, and after Nvidia donated $26 million toward Trump’s projects, including the ballroom. It appears to be asking if Trump used his knowledge of the affair to secure donations from Nvidia. Interestingly, in a “60 Minutes” interview with President Trump that aired on Sunday, Trump mentioned how he and his team had threatened an unnamed AI exec with jail , and after that, the exec “totally changed.” This Congressional investigation into Nvidia’s China sales and its dealings with Trump is the second one, so far, since news of the alleged spy affair broke. The Republican-led group involves leaders from the House Select Committee on the Chinese Communist Party, the House Committee on Foreign Affairs, and the House Intelligence Committee. That group has demanded that Huang come to them and testify in a closed-door session. They had threatened to subpoena him if he didn’t voluntarily agree. On Thursday, after his resignation, he agreed. When you purchase through links in our articles, we may earn a small commission . This doesn’t affect our editorial independence. articles.title: Muse can now place calls to US businesses — if you pay | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Muse's AI can now place outbound calls to U.S. businesses — but it's not free.
articles.body_text: Meta’s Muse, which now has over 10 million users , the company said last month, has been working to make consumer AI a mainstream product for everyday users. Placing calls is one of the ways it aims to get there, as it could handle another task on people’s to-do lists. Notes Alexandr Wang, Meta’s chief AI officer and head of its Superintelligence Labs division, the feature could be used to take care of calls people don’t want to make, like those to their cable company, the DMV, or to a restaurant that doesn’t offer online reservations. 🚨MUSE FEATURE ALERT!!!🚨 lots of you have been asking for this one… muse can make phone calls for you! ☎️📞📲 let muse take care of all those calls you don’t want to make. insurance? cable? DMV? dinner res? not your problem anymore. out now to paid subs in the US 🇺🇸 pic.twitter.com/dsyMNmI2Ub Previously, only a select number of Muse early adopters were able to try this feature after asking the AI for access. Now, anyone who pays for Muse can make this type of request. Currently, Muse subscription plans start at $20 per month for 500 million Muse tokens per week. Heavier AI users can opt to pay $100 per month for 3 billion tokens. Muse is not the only AI agent able to place calls to businesses; the startup Instinct has been offering a similar option , as has Google’s Gemini . However, while the AI tools are now certainly capable of handling the task, the reception on the other end of the line can be mixed. Many businesses and receptionists hang up on calls from AI agents as soon as they identify that it’s not a human on the phone. But with AI now better able to mimic a real human voice, being able to tell the difference between a customer and an AI working on the customer’s behalf will get tougher. Despite the challenges, this feature is one that could appeal to consumers who have grown frustrated with the state of customer service over the years. For too long, customers have been forced to navigate complex phone trees, and then sit on hold waiting for a human representative to pick up. If they’re lucky, that person can actually help them, and not transfer them to another department. Now, those consumers could potentially use their AI, with its infinite patience, for this tedious task instead. While calls remain a paid-only feature for the time being, the recently added option to make a Muse email address will soon roll out to free users, Wang said this week. articles.title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Jensen Huang has resigned from Nvidia following an affair, which could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.
articles.body_text: Nvidia co-founder and now former CEO Jensen Huang has never been as flashy or controversy-prone as AI leaders like OpenAI’s Sam Altman or SpaceXAI’s Elon Musk. Now, the 63-year-old industry kingpin has admitted that he cheated on his wife of 40 years in affairs that could have ramifications beyond Huang’s personal life and U.S. national security. U.S. officials believe that one of Huang’s likely romantic interests, Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, is a Chinese spy who has been feeding information back to Beijing. (Alice Huang, a Chinese citizen, is of no relation to Jensen Huang.) Megaspeed is a Singapore-based AI infrastructure company that reportedly purchased $4.8 billion in Nvidia chips over the last two years. The U.S. and Singapore have both previously investigated Megaspeed over suspicions that the firm was illegally sharing chips with China. The Justice Department has since taken over the federal investigation into the company, The New York Times has reported. The story took a sudden new turn on Wednesday. Citing five people who worked at Nvidia, the Times reported that Huang also had an extramarital relationship with Kimberly Powell, the company’s vice president of healthcare, who reports directly to him. Nvidia, Huang, and Powell have not confirmed the report. Reached by a Times reporter, Huang reportedly said, “I don’t think you should be talking to me directly,” before hanging up. By early Thursday morning, Huang was no longer CEO of the company he co-founded 33 years ago. Then, Thursday afternoon, Reuters dropped another bombshell, publishing a report alleging that Huang had yet another extramarital affair with another unnamed Nvidia employee. The U.S. and China are embroiled in a fierce technological arms race to build the most advanced AI infrastructure, which could shape each country’s economic future, military prowess, and capacity for innovation. Nvidia is valuable in this competition as one of the world’s largest makers of AI chips, which are essential for accelerating AI development. But as an American company, Nvidia faces government restrictions on the sale of its most powerful chips to Chinese entities. As the controversy unfolds, we are organizing the most relevant events into a reverse-chronological timeline to keep you up to date. After Huang was already ousted from Nvidia, we continued to learn more incriminating claims about the former CEO. According to Reuters, Huang had a third affair with an additional, unnamed employee of Nvidia. Nvidia confirmed in an SEC filing on Thursday that the board accepted Huang’s resignation on Wednesday. The company’s current CFO, Colette Kress , will take over as interim CEO while still fulfilling her CFO duties. Nvidia is expected to conduct a larger search to determine a permanent successor to Huang. Harvey C. Jones, a managing partner of Square Wave Ventures and former CEO of Synopsys, was appointed as the company’s first-ever chair of the board of directors. Jones has been on Nvidia’s board since 1993. Later in the day, Huang confirmed that he would testify in Congress at some point before Thanksgiving, which falls on November 26. “Jensen and I have been very at odds as some of you already know on export controls, but Nvidia is a very important company to the United States of America,” House Foreign Affairs Committee Chairman Brian Mast said to reporters. “I don’t want to see anything hurt in Nvidia, but he has some very serious questions to answer.”

articles.title: Nebius tests the neocloud playbook with $40 billion in planned spending | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Nebius plans to fund its $40 billion AI infrastructure expansion through customer prepayments and loans, even as delays at a Microsoft data center raise questions about its financing model.
articles.body_text: In its third-quarter earnings call Thursday, the neocloud company Nebius laid out $40 billion in planned spending for 2027, far more than Wall Street had expected. It’s an ambitious plan, but it rests on a string of planned projects that are already starting to show cracks. Nebius plans to fund the buildout by relying on customer pre-payments and loans backed by customer contracts — essentially using the future value of its data centers to finance their construction. But that can be a risky strategy if those projects get bogged down by delays or cancellations. “Building at this scale is hard, and delays are part of our industry right now,” CEO Arkady Volozh said during Thursday’s earnings call. “We are not immune.” The earnings announcement comes on the heels of reports that Microsoft is cooling on neocloud deals that aren’t delivering on time. That’s a problem for companies like Nebius, whose financing strategy is becoming more dependent on repayments. Because if it can’t get to capacity on time, it will keep piling on costs while revenues slip. One of Nebius’ largest customers is Microsoft, which is paying for AI computing capacity at a Vineland, New Jersey, data center that is now months behind schedule. Nebius’ contract with Microsoft is worth up to $19.4 billion, but it’s already letting deadlines slip. Only just over half of the Microsoft capacity is now planned for delivery by the end of the year, with the rest coming in Q2 2027. The delay is because DataOne, the third-party operator of the site, “decided to wind down the temporary generation faster than it was expected,” according to Andrey Korolenko, chief product and infrastructure officer, as the site switches over to Bloom Energy fuel cells. Still, that transition wasn’t entirely by choice. In August , the investigative site Floodlight identified at least 45 natural gas generators in operation at the DataOne site, even though it had not received any permits for operating gas generators. New Jersey regulators fined the DataOne facility $1.1 million in response, finding that the use of the generators violated federal law. DataOne is also facing a noise-complaint lawsuit from nearby residents over a constant humming noise allegedly emitted by the data center. According to Nebius’ summary of its Microsoft contract, Microsoft can terminate affected service after a grace period if dates are missed and no alternative capacity is offered. The tranches were originally meant to be deployed in 2025 and 2026, so a Q2 2027 delivery date falls well beyond that window. The contract also includes financial penalties for late delivery. Nebius said that Microsoft “has been part of the planning process.” Nebius did not say whether Microsoft has agreed to the new dates, but Microsoft has not publicly canceled anything. TechCrunch has reached out to Nebius, Microsoft, and DataOne for comment. On the call, Marc Boroditsky, Nebius’s chief revenue officer, said the company’s deals with Microsoft and Meta both came with significant prepayment, which arrived long before delivery. But Bloomberg reported last week that Microsoft is tightening oversight on projects run by third parties, including Nebius, IREN, and Nscale, and debating whether it’s worth signing new agreements. Microsoft also sent employees to the site in New Jersey, per Bloomberg.

articles.title: Microsoft's Outlook email hit by new outage | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Microsoft hasn't yet given a cause for the outage, which is affecting Outlook email users.
articles.body_text: Microsoft said its Outlook email service is currently experiencing an outage, preventing both business and consumer users from accessing their inboxes. The issue was initially flagged as affecting the U.S. and the Americas, and later expanded to affect “any region.” Microsoft hasn’t given a specific cause, but said that it was providing updates in its admin center , which wasn’t reachable at the time of publication. In a post on X for users who can’t access the admin center, Microsoft said some of its infrastructure was experiencing “elevated load,” and that it was “redistributing connection traffic across our broader worldwide infrastructure to help balance the load.” In its latest update, Microsoft attributed this incident to “a large number of servers being unexpectedly unavailable,” for reasons it did not explain. Microsoft said it continues to investigate the outage. Microsoft says its video conferencing tool Teams, file sharing platform SharePoint, and its AI tool Copilot are also unavailable. The company says its Defender XDR security system is also affected by the outage. Consumers are also unable to access their OneDrive storage, Office (for the web), and several other Microsoft services during the ongoing outage. TechCrunch will reach out to Microsoft for comment, as soon as our own email service has resumed. The company’s last major incident was in September , when a days-long outage hit Microsoft 365, its online productivity suite that includes Outlook. During that outage, Microsoft blamed a “core authentication configuration” issue that prevented users from accessing the service. articles.title: Hugging Face CEO vows to keep fighting for open source AI after Jensen Huang's exit | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Hugging Face's CEO pledged to keep fighting for open source AI after Huang's exit, raising questions about Nvidia's $12.9 billion acquisition.
articles.body_text: Hugging Face CEO Clément Delangue briefly commented on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s departure on Thursday, calling it a “really sad day.” Nvidia had announced its plan to acquire the platform for open source AI models in September for $12.9 billion, making it the second-largest acquisition in the company’s history, just behind that of chipmaker Groq’s assets for $20 billion in December 2025. “This whole thing sucks, and I wish none of it had happened. It’s a really sad day! But I want to make one thing clear: we’ll keep fighting for open-source AI, harder than ever. This is too important to slow down now. Let’s go!,” Delangue wrote on X. This whole thing sucks, and I wish none of it had happened. It’s a really sad day! But I want to make one thing clear: we’ll keep fighting for open-source AI, harder than ever. This is too important to slow down now. Let’s go! The post is interesting as it implies that Huang’s departure is potentially worrying to open source advocates, and he’s attempting to offer reassurance. As Nvidia’s CEO, Huang was known as a strong advocate for open source AI and open-weight models, which is why there could be concerns about how a company that’s no longer under his leadership will now approach this space. After Nvidia announced its plans to acquire Hugging Face, the U.S. Department of Justice began making inquiries about how the deal would impact competition in the AI market, Reuters reported in October . While Nvidia pledged that the platform would preserve open support, it would also allow the company to control a major distribution channel for AI models. The Hugging Face deal is still scheduled to close in the first half of 2027. Requests for further comment on the deal status and whether Hugging Face has spoken yet with Nvidia’s interim CEO Colette Kress were not returned. Huang’s advocacy for open source and open-weight AI has long extended beyond Hugging Face. In July, the CEO published an AI policy letter as his first-ever post on the social network X . The letter, which was signed by 25 companies, including Microsoft, Meta, Hugging Face, IBM, Palantir, and others, urged the U.S. government not to over-restrict open-weight AI models. It said models that “anyone can download, inspect, modify, and run on their own infrastructure” are an important part of the AI ecosystem because they make AI “more accessible, adaptable, and widely available.” Huang also wrote that open-weight models expand access to the AI economy, strengthen competition, and give customers greater control, as they know they won’t become locked into a single provider. “Open models strengthen safety and cybersecurity, accelerate innovation and diffusion, and enable sovereignty,” his post on X stated. For my first post, I’m sharing a letter @NVIDIA signed on why open models matter. AI will transform every industry, power every company, and be built by every country. Open models strengthen safety and cybersecurity, accelerate innovation and diffusion, and enable sovereignty.… pic.twitter.com/t02bi51N4C In August, Nvidia also announced a $6 billion deal with the coding startup Poolside to help build out an open AI ecosystem in the U.S. to help the country compete against Chinese companies like DeepSeek and Kimi K3, The Wall Street Journal reported at the time. Last month, Nvidia expanded its Nemotron family of open-weight models with a large 120-billion-parameter model for agents used by the enterprise as well as with two new lightweight Bolt models that run on PCs. Earlier this year, Huang promoted open source AI during his January keynote address at the Consumer Electronics Show in Las Vegas, noting that open source models have “really revolutionized artificial intelligence.”

articles.title: SoftBank’s billion-dollar loss may have put a cap on AI's natural gas ambitions | TechCrunch
articles.summary: SoftBank lost over $3 billion preordering natural gas turbines to power AI data centers. Here's what the loss means to power markets.
articles.body_text: SoftBank might not be the first to invest in a hot trend, but when it does, it goes big. Witness its $30 billion bet on OpenAI in early 2025 or its announcement in February that its SB Energy subsidiary would spend $33 billion on a 9.2-gigawatt natural gas power plant. If you can’t be first, be biggest, I guess. That philosophy apparently spilled over into procurement, where orders were also supersized. Starting about two years ago, SoftBank reportedly put down deposits on more than 13 gigawatts of turbines, almost 50% more than it needed. The decision to over-order undoubtedly helped secure turbines and speed up SoftBank’s projects. “SB Energy did not have a choice except to overbook turbines in the future if they wanted some turbines right away,” Peter Gardett, CEO of Noreva , told TechCrunch via email. The energy world was caught off guard by the swiftness and magnitude of AI’s rising power demands. Queues for turbine orders now extend into the early 2030s . As natural gas was shaping up to be a go-to power source for the AI boom, CEO Masayoshi Son bet that by deploying his investment firm’s significant war chest, he could corner a portion of the market. If the AI world wanted power for its data centers, it would have to come to him. Now that bet appears to have fizzled. SoftBank announced a $7.1 billion quarterly loss on Tuesday, with over half of that stemming from losses related to power-generating equipment. The investor had paid turbine manufacturers nonrefundable deposits to secure orders, and now it considered much of those worthless. The move was also a costly bit of price discovery, Gardett said. Rather than overpay and potentially still be short of turbines, SoftBank overpaid and over-ordered. “This charge is just that price discovery finally happening,” Gardett said. The magnitude of that misplaced bet — over $3 billion — reflects some of the electricity mania that has overtaken the AI world. Faced with years-long waits to connect to the grid, many hyperscalers and developers have turned to natural gas as a sort of energy security blanket, something that is proven and familiar. As AI data centers spend more time in operation, their operators are getting a better feel for what’s required to keep them operating. Natural gas might seem like a safe bet, but there are still risks, including winter curtailments when supplies dip and demand spikes, Brent Nelson, senior managing director of markets and strategy at Ascend Analytics , told the Equity podcast Wednesday. In light of that, Nelson said the grid might still be their best bet. Most data centers would be best served by a grid connection, albeit a smaller one than they might normally request. To make up for the shortfall, large batteries are a cost-effective choice, Nelson said. They’d help shave peak loads or ride out requests from the utility to curtail electricity use.

articles.title: Five ways Jensen Huang’s ouster from Nvidia could damage the AI industry | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Nvidia's ousted CEO Jensen Huang's downfall isn’t just your run-of-the-mill salacious billionaire sex scandal. He was using his influence to push the AI industry in some very specific ways.
articles.body_text: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s confession that he had an affair (and reports of another one with a direct report ) that led the board to oust him on Thursday isn’t just your run-of-the-mill salacious billionaire CEO sex scandal. In this case, one of his lovers is suspected by the U.S. government of being a spy for China . She’s also an executive of a Singapore-based neocloud that is suspected of smuggling Nvidia chips to China. These affairs show undeniably poor judgment by Huang and, I’d argue, unchecked hubris on many levels. Such choices are not only a betrayal of his wife of 40 years, they’re also a liability for his company. Sleeping with any Nvidia partner is bad enough, but he also chose one in a tinderbox of a geopolitical situation. Even if Alice Huang’s company wasn’t suspected of helping Chinese firms evade chip restrictions (and he was somehow unaware of this), it was still exploiting a legal loophole by renting powerful AI infrastructure to Chinese companies. It’s those potential national consequences that may land him in a hellscape of ongoing public humiliation. Republican committee chairs are already summoning him to testify in closed-door sessions about the security ramifications. Will Democrats, who are set to take over key committees when the new Congress convenes in January, also haul him in to testify on the Hill? No one knows yet, but Huang has flaunted his close relationship with President Trump. Remember when Trump called him while he was onstage at the All-In Summit in September? Nvidia also donated $25 million to Trump’s ballroom, a deeply unpopular project with American voters. Several Democratic lawmakers have already vowed to investigate the money behind it. In other words, he is a billionaire close to Trump. He was — until Thursday — the face of AI and data centers (also a deeply unpopular political topic with voters), and he has publicly admitted to having an affair with an alleged Chinese spy. Even though he’s no longer CEO, that seems too juicy a target for Democrats to ignore. Beyond whatever may be coming, Huang’s influence has been lost right when he was using it to push the tech industry in a number of directions. These areas have now lost their biggest champion. Huang has been the biggest, loudest advocate for open-weight AI models in the tech industry and among government policymakers. Nvidia not only offers its own open-weight models, it also offers a lot of other open source tech for agents, AI security, and more. It has even agreed to acquire the biggest site that hosts them, Hugging Face, for $12.9 billion. (That deal is supposed to close in the first half of next year, pending regulatory approval.) In July, when Anthropic and OpenAI were reportedly urging the Trump administration to ban Chinese open-weight models, Huang organized a letter of support for open-weight models generally (if not Chinese models specifically), signed by hundreds of tech companies. Open-weight models give enterprises choice in the market and reduce costs. Without Huang, the next biggest advocate for them is perhaps Microsoft’s Satya Nadella, but he’s not out there organizing the industry to speak up. Both OpenAI and Anthropic revealed incident after incident this year as their AI agents hacked into others’ networks or performed other misdeeds. Huang loudly proclaimed the AI industry still didn’t need regulation and would deal with safety itself. As the industry mulled over what they should do ( auditors? a FINRA-like board? ), Huang rallied the tech industry again. Nvidia got over 100 companies to sign on to his Open Agent Safety Platform, a largely open source effort to solve the epidemic of misbehaving AI agents.

articles.title: Jensen Huang is out at Nvidia — who is Colette Kress, his interim replacement? | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Nvidia CFO Colette Kress is taking over as an interim replacement for longtime CEO Jensen Huang, who is embroiled in scandal.
articles.body_text: The Nvidia Board of Directors announced on Thursday morning that the company’s co-founder and CEO of 33 years, Jensen Huang, has resigned as president, CEO, and member of the board, effective immediately. This is a shocking twist for one of the most valuable companies in the world, which designs the chips that make the AI boom possible. Few people would have predicted this turn of events even just a week ago, as Huang has been so central to Nvidia throughout the company’s existence that he never even established a succession plan . But Huang has now been ousted after reports that he had affairs with both an alleged Chinese spy and one of his direct reports at Nvidia. While the company conducts a more thorough search for Huang’s successor, Nvidia CFO and Executive Vice President Colette Kress has taken over as interim CEO. But beyond her name and job title, what do we know about the person who will now lead a company worth about $3.8 trillion? According to Nvidia’s website , Kress has worked at the company since September 2013. Before that, she spent three years as an SVP and CFO of Cisco’s Business Technology Operations Finance organization. She also worked at Microsoft for 13 years, where she spent four years as CFO of the Server and Tools division. She holds a finance degree from the University of Arizona and an MBA from Southern Methodist University. The California-based 59-year-old has a very limited social media presence — on Linkedin , she has commented some well wishes on former colleagues’ posts about their retirement. But as CFO, she’s been a regular presence on Nvidia’s earnings calls, making her a familiar figure for analysts covering the company. According to Forbes’ list of America’s Richest Self-Made Women, Kress’ net worth is estimated to be about $1.2 billion. Her Forbes profile adds that she initially joined Nvidia in part because her two sons endorsed the company for its role in the video game industry, which it was best known for at the time. “Nvidias strength has always come from its people, and together with our leadership team, I am committed to building on the extraordinary foundation Jensen created over the last 33 years,” Kress said in a statement . “We will continue advancing the work that has made Nvidia a leader in accelerated computing and AI, and execute on the opportunities ahead. Our focus remains on serving our customers, partners, developers and shareholders.” Nvidia is slated to report its quarterly earnings on Tuesday, when we will likely hear more from Kress about her plans for the company’s immediate future. [Media: https://www.threads.net/@carnage4life/post/C7zC4oZJY8G/?xmt=AQGziqAUe87CCg3HOoD5h3eV4SK1LsNvle7bsqUDmU37ng] Yet those men also cultivate very different public images than Huang. Instead of hoodies, double polos, thousand-dollar T-shirts, or business suits, he’s typically decked out in some kind of leather jacket. What he wants you to know from that sartorial choice is clear: he’s not like regular CEOs. He’s a cool CEO. And like cool actors and musicians, sometimes people ask CEOs with carefully cultivated images of being cool to also sign their tatas. But I suspect this woman’s desire to get a signature on her dress was driven more by the AI boom that’s led Nvidia to being the third most valuable company on the S&P 500 than by how swanky Huang’s jacket is.

articles.title: JUST NU: Vädjan: Ge er inte ut!
articles.summary: SMHI varnar för snöoväder längs Norrlandskusten. Utanför Skellefteå har det kommit omkring 40 centimeter – och väntas upp till 35 till. Trafikverket har gått ut med en skarp uppmaning. ”Ge dig inte ut i trafiken”‚ skriver myndigheten.
articles.body_text: SMHI varnar för snöoväder längs Norrlandskusten. Utanför Skellefteå har det kommit omkring 40 centimeter – och väntas upp till 35 till. Trafikverket har gått ut med en skarp uppmaning. ”Ge dig inte ut i trafiken”‚ skriver myndigheten. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Det väntas bli en riktig stormig och snöig fredag för stora delar av Sverige. SMHI har utfärdat vädervarningar från Piteå i norr till Ludvika i söder, en sträcka på omkring 670 kilometer. Hittills har det snöat mest i Skellefteåtrakten och vid en mätstation utanför stan har ett snödjup på 40 centimeter uppmätts. Ytterligare mellan 20 och 35 centimeter snö väntas, enligt SMHI:s meteorolog Therese Fougman. Där har det också legat en röd varning, den allra högsta varningsnivån. Men det värsta beräknas nu vara över. På fredagsmorgonen nedgraderades varningen från röd till orange. – I Norrland fortsätter snöfallet, men mattas av allt mer. Det kommer att fortsätta under dagen till någon gång i kväll. De varningar som ligger över Västernorrland, det värsta är över där också. Det ser inte ut att komma så jättemycket mer. I det övriga området, som följer Norrlandskusten ner till Sundsvall och därefter rör sig in i landet över bland annat Falun och Ludvika, råder en gul varning.

articles.title: 100 fordon fast – stopp i timmar
articles.summary: Snöovädret ställer till det rejält på E4 i Västernorrland. Ett stort antal fordon är fast efter en olycka och lastbilar som fått stopp. – Det är dålig sikt, säger larmoperatören Therese Sivertsson till Örnsköldsviks Allehanda.
articles.body_text: Snöovädret ställer till det rejält på E4 i Västernorrland. Ett stort antal fordon är fast efter en olycka och lastbilar som fått stopp. – Det är dålig sikt, säger larmoperatören Therese Sivertsson till Örnsköldsviks Allehanda . Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Uppemot 100 fordon har suttit fast i ett snökaos på E4, enligt Sveriges Radios trafikredaktion . Radion rapporterar att det är stopp över Skuleskogen och Skuleberget i Västernorrland, mellan Bjästa och Docksta, i riktning söderut mot Sundsvall. Det ska ha varit en långtradare som fick problem vid 19.30 och sen ska köerna ha byggts på med flera lastbilar som inte kunnat ta sig därifrån. Vid 22.30 var det uppskattningsvis 60–100 fordon som stod stilla, enligt Sveriges Radios trafikredaktion, som också rapporterar att en tungbärgare jobbar med att få loss ”lastbil efter lastbil”. • Kontakta Expressen på tipsa@expressen.se • Här kan du läsa mer om hur du tipsar Expressen Vid 23.30 blev det även stopp i norrgående riktning efter att flera lastbilar blivit stillastående i Skulebacken. Vid 05-tiden på fredagsmorgonen uppgav Trafikverket att norrgående riktning var framkomlig igen. Men i södergående riktning står flera lastbilar fortfarande stilla, rapporterar Örnsköldsviks Allehanda . En preliminär prognos för när bärgning och snöröjning är utförd är satt till 06.30. articles.body_text: Sen fick han en medalj av försvarsminister. – Bra jobbat, soldat, skriver Hegseth på X. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. En film från händelsen visar hur gruppen tar foton, skrattar och väsnas. – Alla besökare måste upprätthålla en anda av tystnad och respekt hela tiden, ropade en soldat. Nu har soldaten vid namn Thomas Iglesias fått en förtjänstmedalj av Hegseth för sitt rådiga agerande. ”Vi älskar soldater. Vi värnar om höga krav. Bra jobbat, soldat. Efter incidenten vid monumentet dagen innan gick Pentagons högsta talesperson Sean Parnell ut och berömde Iglesias. – Soldaten påminde alla på ett korrekt och respektfullt sätt om att upprätthålla ordningen, sa Parnell, enligt CNN .

articles.title: Mamma och dotter dödade av björnar
articles.summary: En vandringstur blev det sista Jennifer och dottern Selah gjorde tillsammans. De två kvinnorna attackerades och dödades av björnar. – Overkligt, säger Jennifers bror till CBC.
articles.body_text: En vandringstur blev det sista Jennifer och dottern Selah gjorde tillsammans. De två kvinnorna attackerades och dödades av björnar. – Overkligt, säger Jennifers bror till CBC . Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Jennifer Balcarras, 48, och dottern Selah Reed, 20, var ute på en vandring söndag 1 november nära sitt hem i Bella Coola i sydvästra Kanada . Anhöriga slog larm till polis och dagarna efteråt hittades deras kroppar 150 meter ifrån varandra, skriver People . – Det är surrealistiskt, overkligt. Det känns som en dröm, sa Jennifers bror till CBC efter beskedet. Myndigheterna misstänkte tidigt att Balcarras och Reed hade dödats av björnar. Med hjälp av DNA-analyser från platsen kunde en björnhona och tre ungar knytas till händelsen. – Vår utredning visar att attacken sannolikt innefattade ett rovdjursbeteende, vilket jag kan säga är mycket ovanligt. Med det sagt, vi vet inte hur det började, men vi vet hur det slutade, säger utredaren Jeff Tyre, enligt People . I veckan bekräftade myndigheterna att samtliga fyra björnar hittats och avlivats för att skydda allmänheten. I november förra året skadades elva personer när en grupp skolelever och lärare attackerades av björnar. Enligt myndigheterna var björnarna som dödats nu inte inblandade i den händelsen.

articles.title: Finansmannen Erik Penser vittnade i rätten – stödet från Birgitta Härenstam
articles.summary: Den kände finansmannen Erik Penser var nära vän med greve Hans-Gabriel Trolle-Wachtmeister, HG kallad. Nu har Penser vittnat i arvstvisten efter greven.
articles.body_text: Nu vittnar finansmannen Erik Penser, 84, om greve HG Trolle-Wachtmeisters sista år. Greven hade INTE gillat domstolsdramat, tror han. – Han hade nog tyckt att det borde kunnat lösas på annat sätt. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Erik Pensers pappa Wilhelm var känd skånsk advokat och företrädde HG Trolle-Wachtmeister flera gånger. På 80-talet satt Erik Penser själv i företagsstyrelser tillsammans med greven. Resten är historia. – Ganska snabbt kom vi på att vi båda var jaktintresserade och umgicks flitigt. Jag var på Trolle Ljungby två-tre gånger om året och han var hos mig i England. Han var faktiskt en av mina allra bästa vänner. Penser fyllde år i samband med sensommarens andjakt, och i januari när HG hade sin födelsedag höll slottet traditionellt alltid jakt. – Det var till och med så att när jag fyllde 70 hade jag en middag på Trolle Ljungby – med mina vänner och HG och Alice som värdar, berättar Penser som också nämner en Dubairesa och engelska trädgårdar. Efter att han förlorat sin fru Lillemor Penser 2016 träffade han Birigitta Härenstam, 80, som blev ensam i samma period då maken Magnus Härenstam dog. I dag är de ”trolovade”, enligt Birgitta Härenstam. 2019 följde hon med till Trolle Ljungby och träffade greven för första gången. – Men jag hade naturligtvis hört talas om honom eftersom Erik kände honom så väl.

articles.title: Källor: Jensen Huang hade en tredje affär med kollega på Nvidia
articles.summary: Nvidias vd Jensen Huang lämnar företaget efter att två otrohetsaffärer avslöjats. Nu rapporterar Reuters att Huang har haft en tredje affär – med en till kvinna på Nvidia.
articles.body_text: Nvidias vd Jensen Huang lämnar företaget efter att två otrohetsaffärer avslöjats. Nu rapporterar Reuters att Huang har haft en tredje affär – med en till kvinna på Nvidia. Det uppger flera källor för nyhetsbyrån. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Grundaren av chipjätten Nvidia, Jensen Huang, meddelade i dag att han lämnar rollen som vd. Beslutet kom efter att två otrohetsaffärer avslöjats av New York Times . I slutet av oktober rapporterade tidningen att Jensen Huang haft en relation med en kvinna vid namn Alice Huang. Hon pekas ut av den amerikanska underrättelsen för att ha rekryterats att spionera för Kina. Och i går avslöjade NYT att Jensen Huang också haft en affär med Kimberly Powell, vice vd för hälsofrågor på Nvidia. Nu rapporterar Reuters , med hänvisning till två källor, att Huang haft en tredje otrohetsaffär. Den tredje kvinnan ska också vara anställd på Nvidia och därmed underställd Huang. Bägge otrohetsaffärer kan strida mot företagets policy som avråder från relationer som kan ”skapa konflikter”. Reuters har sökt den tredje kvinnan men hon har inte återkommit. De har därför inte publicerat hennes namn. Nvidia vill inte kommentera avslöjandet. Huangs utomäktenskapliga aktiviteter har skapat stort huvudbry för honom själv och Nvidia, världens näst största företag. Sedan skandalen briserade har företaget tappat en biljon dollar i börsvärde, motsvarande 10 biljoner svenska kronor. När hans uttåg offentliggjordes i dag störtdök Nvidia på börsen. Aktien rasade initialt med 13,8 procent. Huang har sedan tidigare erkänt affären med den kinesiska misstänkta spionen. Nvidia har sagt att de ska genomföra en extern utredning om deras relation.

articles.body_text: Ett strömavbrott har inträffat i Gävleborg på fredagsmorgonen. Totalt ska 560 hushåll vara drabbade i Ljusdal, Bollnäs och Ovanåker, uppger Ellevio. Felsökningsarbete pågår. En storskalig drönarattack har riktats mot den ryska huvudstaden Moskva under den sena torsdagskvällen, hävdar stadens borgmästare Sergej Sobjanin. Under natten har även Ukraina anfallits. Tiotals drönare har skjutits ned och avvärjts, skriver Sobjanin på Telegram. Anfallen har påverkat trafiken vid flera flygplatser i Moskva, påstår ryska myndigheter enligt The Kyiv Independent. I Ukraina orsakade splitter från en rysk attackdrönare en brand på ett sjukhus i huvudstaden Kiev under natten, enligt public servicebolaget Suspilne. Knappt 40 personer evakuerades ur byggnanden och en person skadades, uppger den statliga räddningstjänsten. (TT) Det är rejält halt i södra Sverige, varnar Sveriges Radios trafikredaktion. – Från södra Sverige har vi fått flera samtal om att det är förrädisk halka nu på morgonen, det har frusit på, säger Gylsen Bergsdal på trafikredaktionen enligt Ekot . Det har också skett olyckor i morgontrafiken. På väg 23 norr om Hässleholm har en lastbil hamnat i diket. Vägen är avstängd från Ballingslöv gravfält till Algustorp i riktning mot Älmhult . Olyckan inträffade strax efter 05.30 och orsakar stora problem i trafiken. Arbetet på platsen väntas vara klart vid 08 på fredagsmorgonen, enligt Trafikverkets prognos. Under torsdagskvällen inträffade en annan olycka med lastbil på väg 21 väster om Kristianstad, där en lastbil hamnat på sidan i diket. De trafikproblemen var lösta vid 06-tiden. Teknikjätten Microsofts tjänster är fortsatt drabbade av stora störningar.
